videos.caption: which one are u gonna get?? @m.ph by Mary Phillips @NARS Cosmetics @Fenty Beauty @Rare Beauty @Tower 28 Beauty @Natasha Denona @Westman-Atelier @Haus Labs #foundation #bridalmakeup #sephorasale
videos.transcript: I have pretty much every single viral foundation on the market right now, so if you're looking for a new one to get at the Sephora sale, I'm going to help you choose. You already have pretty clear skin and don't usually wear makeup on a regular day, and you want something just a little extra if you're going to a wedding or you're going out to dinner with your girlfriends. You don't really know how to do makeup so well and you just want that little extra oomph, get the Mary Phillips. If you're someone with combination skin, whether you don't have acne or you have acne, but you don't feel like packing on a super matte heavy foundation on top, And again, maybe you wear a little makeup during the week, maybe a skin tint, but again, you want that extra oomph if you're going out, if you're going to a wedding, especially if you're taking photos. Go for the NARS Light Reflecting Foundation. If you have acne prone and very dry skin, like maybe you even have some eczema on your face or your eyelids, go for the Tower 28. And if you're someone with acne prone and oily skin that wants a little more coverage, go for the House Labs. I love this for all ages, but especially if you have mature skin and you're looking for a foundation that gives like a natural satin finish. but that kind of blurs everything in place without settling into those lines go for the westman atelier if you're taking photos let's say you're getting ready for a big photo shoot and the goal is to look like ai either you don't want to spend money on hiring an editor or you're just too lazy to edit it yourself get the natasha genona if your goal is super matte super blurred like almost 2016 level go for the rare beauty and 2016 is not meant to be a negative this is just like that super matte full glam foundation. I wouldn't suggest this if you have dry skin though. And finally, if you're a bride, I would either go for the brand new Fenty Fluid Flex or the Charlotte Tilbury Airbrush Flawless. I love the formula on both of these. However, I will say a lot of Charlotte's complexion colors tend to lean a little neutral and warm. If you have cool toned or very fair skin, I would skip out on this one and go for the Fenty. But if you're a bride, I seriously think that you'll love both of these. I would go to Sephora and get samples of both of these and try them on your face to see which one you like better. And also if you're a bride, but you want slightly more of a natural finish, I would take one of these and mix in a little bit of the Mary Phillips. That's what I did on my wedding and it looked beautiful. I hope this helped and let me know if I missed your favorite foundation or one that you were considering because I can always make a part two. Bye guys!

videos.transcript: This is my bride, Maggie, and she is getting married this Saturday, so we're doing her bridal trial. Maggie isn't afraid of makeup, and she wants a pinky bronzy look. Unless it's really humid outside, I like to add a lot of skin prep to make sure that my brides are really hydrated. So first, I sprayed her face with the Anua Serum Spray, and then I went right over top with the Colleen Rothschild Serum. Maggie doesn't want too much done with her eyebrows, so I'm just very slightly filling them in. This tom ford palette is one of my go-to palettes when i'm working on clients because it's not too pink and it's not too brown So if someone wants something kind of bronzy and pinky, this is what I use since she wants to be really glowy I'm using the color enlightened right on the top of her lids from rare beauty I find that my 2026 brides are choosing a lighter lash something just really soft and wispy One of my favorite products to use on my clients is the milk skin tint. This is going to even everything out, but it's not too heavy It has a lot of hydration and it's going to give a really nice blur to the skin. I also like to use a more lightweight concealer. So I'm using the Tower 28 Serum Concealer. When you see the word serum in a foundation or concealer, you know that it's going to work on a lot of different skin types. Something that is lightweight and fresh is always going to look good. For Maggie, I'm going in with a liquid blush, a liquid contour, and then I go over with a powder blush and a powder contour. Remember, Maggie isn't afraid of makeup and she's okay with having a full look. That's why I'm doing this process. For my clients that want something almost like a no makeup makeup, I usually just do one or the other. One of the products that I really like to use are the Rare Beauty blushes, the powdered ones. I don't use these as an actual blush, as you can see here. I'm just putting it on top of the blush because it's a really intense pink highlighter. So on her teak, I have a liquid blush, a powder blush, a powdered highlighter blush, a highlighter. I'm using Enlightened again from Rare Beauty and then liquid contour and powder contour. This is one of my favorite lip combos. It is Wherever Walnut from Makeup Forever and then I'm using the color Passion from Winky Luxe right on top. That is a lip oil so it's lots of hydration. I also did finish her makeup look with the Anua Serum Spray again to add extra hydration and then this is her finished look.
